```{r include = FALSE}
split_param <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nzchar(as.character(x)) || identical(as.character(x), "none")) character() else unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), "|", fixed = TRUE))
}
finemap_dirs <- split_param(params$finemap_dirs)
labels <- split_param(params$labels)
if (length(labels) != length(finemap_dirs)) labels <- basename(finemap_dirs)
multi_dir <- if (is.null(params$multi_ancestry_dir) || identical(params$multi_ancestry_dir, "none")) "" else
  as.character(params$multi_ancestry_dir)
show <- function(dt, columns, ...) {
  columns <- intersect(columns, names(dt))
  if (nrow(dt) == 0 || length(columns) == 0) return(cat("None.\n\n"))
  knitr::kable(as.data.frame(dt)[, columns, drop = FALSE], digits = 3, ...)
}
```

## How to read these results

Fine-mapping uses LD from the source set in the YAML (`ld_reference`: a reference panel, or the user's own genotypes); the sources used are listed at the end of this report. Reference-panel LD can miscalibrate fine-mapping, more so the larger the GWAS is relative to the panel. Three safeguards are reported here:

* **LD reference and number of signals (L).** Both are chosen in the YAML (`ld_reference`, and `finemap.max_causal`, default 10); the pipeline does not change them. When the GWAS is more than `finemap.max_n_ratio` (default 10) times larger than the LD reference, a warning is shown below and recorded in `LD_SIZE_WARNING`: consider in-sample LD (`ld_reference` on the GWAS), a larger reference, or `max_causal: 1`, for which posterior inclusion probabilities (PIPs) don't depend on the LD matrix.
* **LD mismatch.** For each region, `LD_MISMATCH_S` estimates how inconsistent the z-scores are with the LD (0 = consistent; above `r ld_mismatch_s_threshold` the region is flagged), and `N_LD_OUTLIERS` counts variants whose z-score is unlikely given their neighbours' (SuSiE-RSS diagnostics; Zou et al. 2022). A flipped allele is the typical outlier. By default these variants are only reported; `finemap.remove_ld_outliers: true` removes them and fine-maps again.
* **Flags** (`LD_FLAG`): `OUTLIER_IN_CS` (an LD outlier is in the credible set: treat the set as suspect), `LD_MISMATCH` (the region's s is high: credible sets beyond the lead one may be spurious), `OUTLIERS_IN_REGION`, and `MHC` (region overlaps the MHC, where LD is long-range and fine-mapping is unreliable). Credible sets flagged `OK` have none of these problems.

```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
for (k in seq_along(finemap_dirs)) {
  diagnostics <- finemap_diagnostics(finemap_dirs[k])
  cat("\n\n## ", labels[k], "\n\n", sep = "")
  if ("LD_SIZE_WARNING" %in% names(diagnostics$regions)) cat(ld_size_warning_markdown(diagnostics$regions$LD_SIZE_WARNING))
  print(show(diagnostics$summary, names(diagnostics$summary), caption = "Summary"))
  cs <- diagnostics$credible_sets
  if (nrow(cs) > 0 && "LD_FLAG" %in% names(cs)) cs <- cs[order(cs$LD_FLAG == "OK", -cs$LEAD_PIP)]
  cat("\n\n### Credible sets (flagged first)\n\n")
  print(show(cs, c("LOCUS", "CS", "CS_SIZE", "LEAD_RSID", "LEAD_SNP", "LEAD_PIP", "MIN_ABS_CORR", "LD_MISMATCH_S",
                   "N_LD_OUTLIERS_IN_CS", "LEAD_IN_TILE_CORE", "LD_FLAG")))
  cat("\n\n### Regions\n\n")
  print(show(diagnostics$regions, c("LOCUS", "STATUS", "N_SNPS", "N_CS", "L", "N_GWAS", "N_REF", "LD_MISMATCH_S",
                                    "N_LD_OUTLIERS", "N_ALLELE_MISMATCH", "MHC", "LD_FLAG")))
}
```

```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (nzchar(multi_dir) && dir.exists(multi_dir)) {
  cat("\n\n## Multi-ancestry fine-mapping (MultiSuSiE)\n\n")
  settings_file <- file.path(multi_dir, "multisusie_settings.tsv")
  if (file.exists(settings_file)) {
    settings <- data.table::fread(settings_file)
    if ("LD_SIZE_WARNING" %in% names(settings)) cat(ld_size_warning_markdown(settings$LD_SIZE_WARNING))
    print(show(settings, c("ANCESTRY", "N_GWAS", "N_REF", "LD_REFERENCE", "L", "REGION_STRATEGY"),
               caption = "Settings per ancestry"))
  }
  regions_file <- file.path(multi_dir, "multisusie_regions.tsv")
  if (file.exists(regions_file)) {
    regions <- data.table::fread(regions_file)
    cat("\n\n### Regions\n\nLD diagnostics are computed separately for each ancestry's LD reference.\n\n")
    print(show(regions, names(regions)))
  }
  cs_files <- list.files(multi_dir, pattern = "_locus_credible_sets\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(cs_files) > 0) {
    cs <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(cs_files, data.table::fread), fill = TRUE)
    if ("LD_FLAG" %in% names(cs)) cs <- cs[order(cs$LD_FLAG == "OK")]
    cat("\n\n### Credible sets (flagged first)\n\n")
    print(show(cs, intersect(c("LOCUS", "CS_ID", "CS_SIZE", "TOP_SNP", "TOP_SNP_RSID", "TOP_SNP_PIP", "PURITY", "PASS_FILTER", "LD_FLAG"),
                             names(cs))))
  }
}
```
